about.title: A quiet room for a busy campus.
about.intro1: The Central Library is where the campus comes to read, think and finish things. Five floors of open shelves, a reading room with long tables and tall windows, and a circulation desk that knows most readers by name.
about.intro2: MY / BOOK is our online counter: search the catalog, reserve what you need, and we'll have it waiting for you at the desk — usually within a few hours.
about.imageAlt: The library atrium: five floors of open shelves under a skylight
about.visitTitle: Find us on the main campus
about.hoursNote: The circulation desk closes 15 minutes before the library. The 24-hour return slot is to the left of the main entrance.
about.floorsNote: Every catalog record shows the floor next to the shelf code.

rules.renewText: Only if nobody is waiting and the book isn't overdue.
rules.pickupText: After your book is set aside. Sundays don't count.

access: Step-free main entrance and a lift to every floor
Height-adjustable desks in the Reading Room
We fetch books from any floor — just ask at the desk
This site works with screen readers and keyboard only
faq: Can people outside the university borrow?
Visitors can read in the library with ID. Borrowing is for students, staff and alumni members.
What if I don't collect my reservation?
It expires and the book goes to the next reader. There's no fine for that.
Can I suggest a book we don't have?
Yes — write to the address below or stop by the desk. Course readings get priority.
Can I eat or drink inside?
Water and covered drinks are fine everywhere. Food stays in the ground-floor foyer.
about.privacyText: We keep only what lending needs: your name, email, student number and loan history. You can download your data from Profile & settings and close your account once every book is back.
